name: One of Everything
summary:
One of Everything is an MBF21 project where the mappers had to fulfil increasingly growing demands for the industrial mapping machine. The requirements start simple, but get progressively more complicated and involved. And here is the twist - the requirements are cumulative, so with each map a new requirement is added, but all the previous requirements still stay.

Did the mappers succeed or are they getting fired from the omnipotent mapping factory? It is up to you to decide.
